skill.summary: Scan, fix, and remediate security vulnerabilities in a local code repository using Mobb MCP/CLI. Use when the user asks to scan for vulnerabilities, run a security check, auto-fix issues, remediate findings, or apply Mobb fixes (e.g., \"scan this repo\", \"fix security issues\", \"remediate vulnerabilities\", \"run Mobb on my changes\").
